responsibility: Defines a small target-local interval-set utility used by the AVR backend to represent finite unions of integer subranges over a fixed bounded domain, typically the value space of an N-bit signed or unsigned mode. The `Ranges` class supports normalized storage of nonempty disjoint subintervals and stable set operations such as complement, intersection, union, set difference, cardinality queries, and construction of truth sets for RTL comparison codes; it exists as a simpler closed-under-operations alternative to GCC’s generic value-range classes for AVR analyses that need predictable bounded-range reasoning.
